note: Saga's existing first-meeting sentences, split into beats without new words. Hunt chance stays on the button and off this prose. text on each event remains the fallback.

beats.text: {catName} stands on the path ahead, leaving enough space for you to stop.
“A stranger should give a name before coming closer.”
{catName} stops a few paces away and looks you over.
“Alone? Then those tracks behind you are all yours.”
{catName} is closer than you expected, watching from beside a tree.
